about: The alleluia of the formulary “Mass of the Easter Vigil” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

s01.narrative: The celebrant intones Alleluia three times, raising his voice each time, and all repeat it after each intonation.

s02.translation: Alleluia. Give praise to the Lord, for He is good, for His mercy endures forever. Praise the Lord, all nations, and praise Him together, all peoples. For His mercy toward us has been made firm, and the truth of the Lord remains forever.

alignments.gloss: His mercy toward us has been made firm

w005.explanation: The adjective is the predicate of an understood subject, the Lord, with the verb left out: “for [He is] good”.

w021.explanation: Confirmata est describes mercy as made firm. Super nos points to us as its recipients.
